# AniStream v2.1.0

A new look, a new Search, our own video player with Skip opening and ending, and anime downloads
you can watch offline.

## New

- 🎉 New look: A slim side rail replaces the top bar, with a darker theme and new window controls
  on Windows. Hover the rail to see each section's name
- 🎉 Search, redesigned: Search Anime, Manga or Movies & TV with results as you type, suggestions,
  filters, studios and characters, and "Did you mean" for typos. Recent searches can be kept on
  this device (switch it off in **Settings**)
- 🎉 Our own player: Anime episodes can play in AniStream's own player, with **Skip opening** and
  **Skip ending**, previews when you seek, and a choice of audio and subtitles. If the main player
  can't play an episode, the backup player takes over by itself
- 🎉 Downloads: Download anime episodes and watch them offline from the new **Downloads** page.
  Title pages you've opened before also work offline
- 🎉 For You without an account: Recommendations now work without signing in, learning from what
  you watch and read on this device
- 🎉 Story arcs: Long-running shows without separate seasons can be browsed by arc

## Better

- ⚡️ Trending and For You stay loaded when you switch between Anime, Manga and More, and refresh
  quietly in the background for your next visit
- ⚡️ Search opens instantly and keeps your results (including **Show more**) when you come back to
  it
- ⚡️ Next-episode countdown: Now matches the **Skip opening** button and shows in fullscreen on
  every player. Cancel keeps a **Next episode** button
- ⚡️ Movies & TV: A new first player for movies and shows with a cleaner interface. Title pages
  open faster, with their logos and details saved on this device
- ⚡️ Episode lists: Episodes that have aired but aren't available yet are named above the list
  instead of showing tiles that can't play
- ⚡️ Titles show in English by default
- ⚡️ Manga: When a series has a regular and a colored edition, AniStream picks the one with
  chapters in your language

## Fixed

- 🦺 Movies & TV: Watching the next episode inside the player now updates Continue Watching, and
  finished episodes are remembered, so AniStream offers the right next episode
- 🦺 Anime opened from For You sometimes listed only one episode
- 🦺 **Not interested** on Anime and Manga For You cards couldn't be clicked
- 🦺 Completed shows could stay in Continue Watching
- 🦺 A new AniList profile picture or banner didn't show until much later

## Downloads

- `AniStream-2.1.0-arm64.dmg`: Apple Silicon macOS 12+
- `AniStream.Setup.2.1.0.exe`: Windows x64

On Windows, AniStream 2.0.1 downloads this update in the background and installs it when you
choose **Restart to update**. You can also install over your existing copy; your data and AniList
session are kept. macOS links to this release page.

Both packages are unsigned. On Windows, select **More info → Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns
you. On macOS, choose **Open Anyway** in **System Settings → Privacy & Security** after the first
launch. Each download can be checked against the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
